column1: # OCR engine swap, measured on the game host 2026-10-27 (spec §14.4).
# engine labels: -rec = rec-only on ONE text band (spec §14.3's shape);
#   -full = the same wheel with detection on, over the whole popup panel.
#   3 panels x 14 bands; ms is wall-clock per call (rec rows: p95 of the bands).
# CORRECTION 2026-10-27: an earlier revision of this file recorded the surya
#   rows as text_len=0 / 'not measurable'. That was the INSTRUMENT'S bug —
#   it passed device= to RecognitionPredictor instead of FoundationPredictor.
#   With the pre-swap call shape the old engine works, and costs 26-35 s per
#   panel (13 lines), i.e. ~40x the new engine's panel path.
# agree_with_human=unverified on every row: a human verdict is not something
#   the instrument can produce. Engine-vs-engine text agreement is recorded
#   separately (see the ocr swap section of docs/offline-tooling.md).
